headline: Sadly, this $1,549 RTX 5070-equipped gaming PC is a very good deal
summary: Walmart offers a CyberPowerPC gaming PC for $1,549, nearly $600 off. It features an Intel Core i7-14700KF processor and 32GB RAM. Equipped with an RTX 5070, it's considered a strong deal despite high component prices.

headline: Jensen Huang talks about AI and climate change like a supervillain
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang discussed AI's role in fighting climate change on The Ezra Klein Show. He stated AI would first inflict "enormous pain and suffering" before helping the planet. His comments drew comparisons to a supervillain's rhetoric.

headline: Meta is going to let you build games with AI right on your phone
summary: Meta is launching new AI development tools for its Horizon social platform. Horizon Create (mobile app) and Horizon Studio (browser app) will enable AI-prompted game creation. This initiative aims to boost game development within the Horizon ecosystem.

headline: Muse will apparently let you download its entire filesystem
summary: Developers claim Meta's Muse AI can be prompted to share its entire filesystem. Peter James and Jonny L. Saunders independently accessed root files and internal documentation. This raises questions about the security and access controls of Meta's AI.

headline: Robert Pattinson Casts Doubt on a Crossover Between His Batman and James Gunn's Superman
summary: Robert Pattinson doubts a crossover between his Batman and James Gunn's Superman is likely. He finds it hard to imagine their distinct universes co-existing. This casts skepticism on potential future DC cinematic universe integrations for his character.

headline: Spider-Man's Jacob Batalon Explains What Destin Daniel Cretton Likes Most About Naruto and Why Team 7 Could Be the Movie's Focus
summary: Jacob Batalon shared insights into Destin Daniel Cretton's vision for the Naruto live-action adaptation. Cretton's focus on key Naruto elements suggests Team 7 might be central to the movie. Batalon's comments offer fans a glimpse into the film's potential direction.

headline: The Back to the Future 4K Blu-ray Trilogy Drops to Its Lowest Price Ever at Gruv
summary: The 'Back to the Future' 4K Blu-ray Trilogy has reached its lowest price ever. This significant deal is currently available through Gruv. Fans can now grab the iconic movie set at a substantial discount.

headline: The Talix 20,000mAh 190W Power Bank Drops to Just $29.99 Ahead of Amazon Prime Day
summary: A Talix 20,000mAh 190W power bank is on sale for $29.99. This deal is available ahead of Amazon Prime Day. It can fast-charge devices like the MacBook Pro 16" M5 and ASUS ROG Xbox Ally X20.

headline: Watch: Why has Trump been so eager to welcome Xi?
summary: Former President Donald Trump has eagerly anticipated Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit for months. The BBC's Sarah Smith investigates the reasons behind Trump's enthusiasm. This video explores the political motivations for the warm welcome.

headline: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order
summary: The White House has restored media access to outlets previously banned by the Trump administration. This action follows a judge's direct order. Lawyers for CNN, Politico, and MS Now claim the White House repeatedly violated the initial order.

headline: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
summary: Poland suspects sabotage behind a fire at a Starlink satellite station. The station provides internet coverage to neighboring Ukraine. Denmark concurrently issued a warning about a growing Russian threat.

headline: Watch: UN delegates walk out of Netanyahu speech
summary: UN delegates staged a walkout during Benjamin Netanyahu's speech. The Israeli delegation remained and cheered in support. The incident highlights political tensions during the address.
